WageTaxRemittance.title: Wage tax remittance
WageTaxRemittance.description: Each time humaniq hands a confirmed wage tax return to the bookkeeping app as a draft payable to the Belastingdienst, this records it. It is a log of the hand-off, never the payable itself (payroll-wage-tax-remittance-shillinq).

payrollRunId.title: Payroll run
payrollRunId.description: The payroll run whose wage tax return this pays.

filingId.title: Wage tax return
filingId.description: The confirmed wage tax return this pays.
filingId.x-notes: At most one created record per return (D5).

administrationId.title: Administration ID
administrationId.description: The administration of the payroll run.

status.title: Status
status.description: How the hand-off ended. Ready in bookkeeping means a draft payable waits there: nobody has paid yet.
status.x-notes: created = draft APTransaction in shillinq, not paid. failed, skipped-no-shillinq and nothing-to-pay are tried again on the next occ humaniq:wagetax:remit.

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: The total to pay on the return, in euros.
amount.x-notes: collectiveTotals.TotGen of the return: wage tax plus the employee insurance premiums and the Zvw contribution (D2).

paymentReference.title: Payment reference
paymentReference.description: The Belastingdienst payment reference the payment carries.

dueDate.title: Due date
dueDate.description: The last day to pay, from the return.

shillinqPayableRef.title: Payable in bookkeeping
shillinqPayableRef.description: The draft payable this hand-off wrote in the bookkeeping app.
shillinqPayableRef.x-notes: shillinq APTransaction id; a plain string, not $ref, because it lives in another app's register (ADR-062 rule 7).

errorMessage.title: Reason
errorMessage.description: Why the hand-off failed or was skipped, and what to fix.

createdAt.title: Handed over at
createdAt.description: When the payable was written to the bookkeeping app.
